---
title: "Chart Taxonomy"
subtitle: "Goal categories and scored candidate charts from chartTypeMapper.js"
---

VizAdvisor maps each visualization **goal** to a ranked list of chart candidates. Scores guide the LLM’s candidate evaluation stage and provide a deterministic baseline for tests.

Source of truth: `src/utils/chartTypeMapper.js`.

## Goal → candidates

### Comparison

| Chart | Score | Best for | Notes |
|-------|------:|----------|-------|
| Bar chart | 10 | nominal, ordinal | Primary |
| Grouped bar chart | 9 | nominal, ordinal | Needs ≥2 series columns |
| Dot plot | 7 | nominal | |
| Radar chart | 4 | ordinal | Use only when shape pattern matters; max 10 axes |

### Trend

| Chart | Score | Best for | Notes |
|-------|------:|----------|-------|
| Line chart | 10 | temporal | Primary |
| Area chart | 8 | temporal | |
| Stacked area | 6 | temporal | ≥2 series |
| Candlestick | 5 | temporal | Financial domain |

### Distribution

| Chart | Score | Best for | Notes |
|-------|------:|----------|-------|
| Histogram | 10 | quantitative | Primary |
| Density plot | 9 | quantitative | |
| Box plot | 8 | quantitative | |
| Violin plot | 7 | quantitative | |
| Beeswarm | 5 | quantitative | Prefer ≤300 rows |

### Correlation

| Chart | Score | Best for | Notes |
|-------|------:|----------|-------|
| Scatter plot | 10 | quantitative | Primary |
| Bubble chart | 8 | quantitative | ≥3 columns |
| Heatmap | 7 | quantitative, ordinal | |
| Parallel coordinates | 6 | quantitative | ≥4 columns |

### Part-of-whole

| Chart | Score | Best for | Notes |
|-------|------:|----------|-------|
| Stacked bar | 10 | nominal, ordinal | Primary |
| Treemap | 8 | nominal | |
| Waffle chart | 6 | nominal | ≤4 categories |
| Pie chart | 5 | nominal | ≤5 categories |
| Donut chart | 5 | nominal | ≤5 categories |

### Geospatial

| Chart | Score | Best for |
|-------|------:|----------|
| Choropleth map | 10 | geographic |
| Symbol map | 9 | geographic |
| Dot density map | 7 | geographic |
| Flow map | 6 | geographic |

### Network & flow

| Chart | Score | Best for |
|-------|------:|----------|
| Sankey diagram | 10 | nominal |
| Chord diagram | 8 | nominal |
| Force graph | 7 | nominal |
| Tree / dendrogram | 6 | nominal |

### Ranking

| Chart | Score | Best for |
|-------|------:|----------|
| Sorted bar chart | 10 | nominal, ordinal |
| Lollipop chart | 8 | nominal |
| Bump chart | 7 | nominal, temporal |
| Slope chart | 6 | nominal, temporal |

## Golden-path fixtures

Prompt evaluation fixtures under `tests/prompts/` encode expected chart families:

| Fixture | Goal | Expected primary family |
|---------|------|-------------------------|
| `comparison-goal.json` | Sales by category | bar (must not recommend pie / 3D / rainbow) |
| `trend-goal.json` | Time series | line / area family |
| `distribution-goal.json` | Numeric spread | histogram / density / box family |

```bash
npm run test:prompts
```
